subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.md@commonmark` is this plugin's own self-contained CommonMark markdown file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, insert-block, remove-block, replace-block, set-inlines, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
